thread:
mina: CI started failing on `redwoodctl login --non-interactive` after we bumped the proxy-cache plugin. Only on our linux runners.

devx-bot: Please paste the error.

mina: short log:
```
error: token cache write failed: permission denied
failed to complete login: could not persist credentials
```

aj: Sounds like a write/rename across mounts. Where is creds file?

mina: Default `~/.config/redwood/credentials.json`, but in CI we symlinked that to /work/ci/shared-creds. The plugin writes via atomic rename which fails across the overlay.

sam: The plugin also creates `/root/.cache/redwood/plugin-proxy` in some images which becomes root-owned. Mixed owners + symlink = trouble.

leo: Short-term: ensure creds live on local fs in runner before login. e.g. copy and chown into $HOME/.config/redwood then run login.

devx-bot: Filed DX-4330 to add plugin fallback to write-temp-in-dir and to honor REDWOODCTL_CACHE_DIR.

mina: Thanks — workaround added to CI and tests green now.
